name: Immoral Joubo Hazard
original_name: インモラル・情母・ハザード
source:
Repeated wet dreams. 
Sayuri Moronaga, has been having nightly dreams. Dreams with such immoral content that when she wakes up in the morning she finds her underwear soiled...
She was glad they were just dreams.
The person she's with in these dreams is her son Yuhei.
Sayuri, who has been estranged from sexual matters for a long time because her husband Masaki is sent to work abroad, feels ashamed of herself for feeling so much frustration. And at the same time, even though they are dreams, the person in them is her own child. She wonders if she really has such desires.
Then one day... things take an unexpected turn...
translation:
反复出现的春梦。
诸永小百合每晚都会做梦。梦境内容如此悖德，每当清晨醒来，她都会发现内裤已经湿透……
幸好，那些都只是梦。
可梦中与她纠缠的人，竟是亲生儿子悠平。
丈夫正树被派往海外工作，小百合已经很久没有接触性爱。她为自己竟如此欲求不满而羞愧；与此同时，即便一切只发生在梦里，对方终究是自己的孩子。她不禁怀疑，难道内心真的藏着这种欲望？
后来某天……事情朝出人意料的方向发展……
